note: Independent re-audit (2026-11-23) of RFC 7947 Section 2.1: "A route server MUST accept all UPDATE messages received from each of its clients for inclusion in its Adj-RIB-In." (alongside Section 2.1 Loc-RIB policy omission). On non-teardown ingress denial or mixed-UPDATE denied announcements for an rs-client peer (reactor_notify.go::retainDeniedIngress: hasPeer && src.RSClient), enqueueFilteredIngress queues withdrawals on update followed by original pre-policy bytes on update-filtered (EventKindUpdateFiltered), skipping recentUpdates, RS fast path, AIGP, and EventBus; bgp-adj-rib-in (rib.go::handleReceivedStructured) stores ImportFiltered:true and FilterStep independently of RPKI Ineligible while walkReplayRoutes, replayPathCommand, routeEligible, and applyToInstalled withhold ImportFiltered entries unconditionally. Positive (TestRFC7947ClientDeniedUpdateRetainedInAdjRIBIn) drives real TCP sessions in lowLiveRouter across both ingress denial stages (LoopIngress and peer-policy-chain), asserting exact pre-policy AttrHex, NLRIHex, filtered:true, filter-step, status totals (total-routes=2, filtered-routes=1), and replay withholding while keeping the accepted control (203.0.113.0/24) stored and replayable. Negative (TestRFC7947OrdinaryPeerDeniedUpdateAbsentFromAdjRIBIn) runs the identical fixture with source.RSClient=false and asserts absence from show bgp adj-rib-in and replay withholding while confirming the accepted control route. Both polarities carry verified revert discrimination records (enqueueFilteredIngress positive, retainDeniedIngress negative). Minor non-blocking notes: loop-denial checks FilterStep NotEmpty rather than literal "loop", import-policy-denial confirms identity via len(rows)==1 + ReplayPathCommand rather than direct NLRIHex, and newFilteredReceivedLive grants "*" while TestReceiveGrantAcceptsUpdateFilteredToken validates the explicit update-filtered token.
